prompt: A single emblem for the back of every card in Odin's deck: the spear Gungnir standing perfectly upright through the centre, its long leaf-shaped iron blade at the top, the shaft carved with knotwork, inside a circular ring of carved Elder Futhark runes, as if cut into a stone or a silver disc. Rendered in worn gold leaf and dark iron, rustic 1990s hand-painted style, symmetrical and centred on a fully transparent background. No letters of the Latin alphabet, no words, no circle or badge behind the ring.
